description: RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc fails on jmap-calendars-client due to two 'redundant explicit link target' diagnostics at src/lib.rs lines 35 and 40 (links of form [`SessionClient`](methods::SessionClient) where the label already resolves). Pre-existing — not caused by JMAP-g7wu.6. Fix: drop the explicit (methods::SessionClient) target, the bare [`SessionClient`] reference resolves via the same intra-doc path.
title: rustdoc redundant link target in jmap-calendars-client/src/lib.rs:35 and :40
